entries.en: to reveal a secret; to let a secret out.
entries.notes: H 欄末字有疑（洩/淺），M sîer 可證其為「洩」；R 欄首音 kān 與「漏」lāu 不合，故降 medium。

entries.en: to leak a secret; to divulge confidential matters.

entries.zh: 把心裡話全說出來；傾訴胸中之事。
entries.en: to pour out what is in one's heart; to speak out one's inmost thoughts.
entries.notes: H 欄「杭/枕」與 M qǔi(kí) 不合，依音義當作「機」，即「透機話」——把話說透。

entries.en: bareheaded; with the head uncovered, wearing no hat.

entries.zh: 沒有主意；不知如何是好（引申為漫不經心、欠考慮）。
entries.en: without a plan; at a loss; hence heedless, thoughtless.

entries.zh: 不管事；不理會事情（疏於照料職分）。
entries.en: to neglect one's affairs; to take no heed of business.
entries.notes: M puē 對「不」、R 欄作 gūn，均非常讀，疑有訛書；H「不理事」與 L 義相合。
H 欄「騎虎不抗耳」字面費解（疑為俗語而末字失真），R 欄末作 'ill'（污損），僅能據 L「Descuidado」定為粗心大意。

entries.zh: 全不懂事；一點也不明白事理。
entries.en: without understanding; muddle-headed, knowing no better.
in that manner; like that; thus.

entries.zh: 那樣式；那般的樣子（可作模樣、範本解）。
entries.en: in that manner; of that kind; a pattern or model.

entries.zh: 一（數目「一」；於此疑為「一生」之首字）。
entries.en: one (here probably the first element of 一生, "from birth").
entries.notes: L 欄空白，據 H/M/R 定為「一」，並由次條「一生做人」推其為「一生」之首字。

entries.en: to be born; birth (as in 一生, "a whole life").
entries.notes: L 欄空白，M sẽg、R sĕng 皆對「生」，由次條「一生做人」定其義。

entries.zh: 一生做人：從出生到長大成人；一輩子做人處世。
entries.en: from birth until one becomes a grown man; to live out one's life as a person.
from childhood to adulthood; from small until grown.
from now on; from this time forward.

entries.zh: 始終如一；從頭到尾一致不變。
entries.en: consistent from beginning to end; unchanging throughout.
